risk_note: RV2 (db / risk). Migration 0056 widens risk_judgements_ref_type_check and risk_hits_ref_type_check with invite_reward (0044 pattern: widening only, no new column, no grant change). The same-device check accepts refs { type: 'invite_reward', id, party: 'inviter' | 'invitee' } and stores ref_id <reward id>:<party> (lock key, lookup, judgement and hit rows), so both parties of one reward are judged and replayed independently (Codex money r1 S0 fixed); withdrawal refs unchanged; a ref without a valid party is refused before any write. Whether to grant stays with B1-35 (BR-ID-37: judged at reward grant; only the marked party is not paid). Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
